description: This file defines the GithubIdentityProviderException class, which extends IdentityProviderException and provides static methods to create exceptions based on HTTP response data during OAuth2 authentication flow for GitHub.

classes.name: GithubIdentityProviderException
classes.description: A specialized exception class for handling GitHub OAuth2 identity provider errors, extends IdentityProviderException and provides static methods to generate exceptions from HTTP responses.

methods.name: clientException
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from an HTTP response and data, using 'message' from data if available, otherwise uses the response's reason phrase.

methods.name: oauthException
methods.description: Creates an OAuth exception instance from an HTTP response and data, using 'error' from data if available, otherwise uses the response's reason phrase.

methods.name: fromResponse
methods.description: Protected method that constructs an exception using the response and optional message, including response status code and body.
